extraction.Name: Cornelius Ellston
extraction.Refused/Protested: No. I had the impression from conversations heard that I could not reject it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I mortgaged it and lost it.
extraction.Buyer: First State Bank of Herrick; land put up as security for $2000.00; the bank afterwards failed.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I was in the First State Bank of Herrick as assistant cashier and held some stock and was assessed 100% so the land was put up as security as $2000.00. The bank afterwards failed.
extraction.Fee Patent Date: not stated; delivered before allottee was 21, sent by mail
extraction.NOTES: Born May 7, 1897; birth information from baptism certificate and family bible; does not remember signing receipt for patent; has three children; in good health; did not ask for the patent; document notarized May 1, 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32.
